author: OhLookItsDaOne
description: Automatically posts a configured troubleshooting message when a new thread is created in a designated forum channel. Also provides `/privacy` to display the privacy policy and `/setprivacypolicy` (admin) to update it.
install_msg: Cog installed. Configure it with `[p]forumhelp`, set the privacy policy with `[p]setprivacypolicy`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild configuration (forum channel ID, troubleshooting message and privacy policy URL). No end user data is stored.
